_doc: Physical chess boards per world. seatA/seatB are the two stand cells; standing on a free seat offers/joins a game (server chess.ts). `npc` names a resident opponent whose placed NPC stands on seatB — the board then plays you itself. Overridable per-world without a deploy via live/tuning/chess.json {worlds:{<world>:[...]}} — same shape, live wins. `sprite`/`bubble` are /assets paths for the in-world board art and the challenge speech bubble; absent -> generated placeholder / drawn bubble.
